cases.contract: start/stop/service/stack/caddy/serve/restart-all/skill/completion command tree
cases.trigger: Walk root and nested help for every visible Go command.
cases.effect: Rust exposes the same command and short/long flag names.
cases.failure: Unknown commands exit nonzero on stderr.
cases.cleanup: No state or child is created.
cases.remaining: Help presentation is framework-specific; compare availability, not prose.

cases.contract: long and short flags, defaults and environment precedence
cases.trigger: Pass explicit and environment manifests, Boolean values and short flags.
cases.effect: Explicit manifest wins; values and defaults select identical services.
cases.failure: Invalid Boolean, missing value and conflicting flags fail.
cases.cleanup: Read-only cases leave fixture files unchanged.
cases.remaining: Add native successful short-flag lifecycle assertions where not covered by corpus.

cases.contract: human and agent output, stderr errors and exit codes
cases.trigger: Inspect live, starting, failed and absent stacks in both output modes.
cases.effect: Status, readiness exit code and failure context agree.
cases.failure: Malformed or unreachable control endpoints report errors on stderr.
cases.cleanup: Join the loopback control peer.
cases.remaining: CLI parser diagnostic wording is framework-specific.

cases.contract: Bash/Zsh/Fish/PowerShell completion registration
cases.trigger: Generate Bash/Zsh/Fish/PowerShell scripts; invoke native Bash Tab completion.
cases.effect: Scripts register the command; Bash offers commands, subcommands and flags.
cases.failure: Extra arguments fail; unsupported-shell exit status requires an explicit compatibility decision.
cases.cleanup: Close PTY and join shell.
cases.remaining: Run native Zsh/Fish/PowerShell candidate checks; registration substrings alone are insufficient.

cases.contract: bounded terminal width and help guidance
cases.trigger: Request human and agent help at wide and narrow terminal widths.
cases.effect: Human help fits its terminal; agent help remains stable and includes skill guidance.
cases.failure: Invalid invocation points to usage without success output.
cases.cleanup: No state or process is created.
cases.remaining: Retain final native-platform receipts; unsupported-shell exit status is pending a compatibility decision.

cases.contract: cwd-to-Git-root discovery and explicit manifest precedence
cases.trigger: Discover from nested and symlinked paths, stop at Git root, then pass an explicit manifest.
cases.effect: Selected manifest identity and relative service paths agree.
cases.failure: An absent explicit path fails without falling back.
cases.cleanup: Remove isolated repository and symlinks.
cases.remaining: Retain final native-platform execution receipts; nested path correction is an explicit unchanged-Go defect.

cases.contract: TOML syntax, unknown keys and aggregate diagnostics
cases.trigger: Load malformed TOML, unknown keys and several invalid services.
cases.effect: Both executables report applicable issues and reject the manifest.
cases.failure: Rejected content starts no service.
cases.cleanup: Remove corpus fixture state.
cases.remaining: Parser diagnostic wording may differ; preserve keys, locations and exit status.

cases.contract: nested includes, duplicate conflicts and relative cwd resolution
cases.trigger: Load nested includes, duplicate declarations and include-relative working directories.
cases.effect: Merged selection, dependency order and child cwd agree.
cases.failure: Duplicate conflicts are rejected; include cycles read each manifest once.
cases.cleanup: Stop all selected services before removing included files.
cases.remaining: Retain final native-platform execution receipts; nested path correction is an explicit unchanged-Go defect.

cases.contract: environment interpolation, missing variables and non-UTF-8 environment
cases.trigger: Interpolate present/missing variables and start with a non-UTF-8 environment entry.
cases.effect: Opaque environment survives process launch; valid interpolation resolves.
cases.failure: Missing required interpolation produces a diagnostic without panic.
cases.cleanup: Stop the child and remove its private environment fixture.
cases.remaining: Retain final native-platform execution receipts; nested path correction is an explicit unchanged-Go defect.

cases.contract: all devtools/worktrees/service/health/lifecycle schema fields
cases.trigger: Parse all devtools, worktree, service, health and lifecycle fields.
cases.effect: Valid full schema selects services; invalid types and combinations fail.
cases.failure: Unknown or conflicting settings cannot silently apply.
cases.cleanup: No runtime starts for schema corpora.
cases.remaining: Schema acceptance is checked; each setting's runtime effect belongs to its feature case below.

cases.contract: config and state directory overrides and XDG/home fallback
cases.trigger: Select explicit config/state directories and XDG/home defaults.
cases.effect: Reads and writes occur only in the selected directories.
cases.failure: Unusable selected paths report errors without fallback.
cases.cleanup: Use private homes and remove only fixture-owned directories.
cases.remaining: Retain final native-platform execution receipts for private config precedence and state-certificate fallback.

cases.contract: local suffix, Caddy listener settings and validation
cases.trigger: Start isolated Caddy with custom suffix, bind host, HTTP and HTTPS ports.
cases.effect: Only configured listeners and hostnames respond.
cases.failure: Invalid listeners/settings fail before mutation.
cases.cleanup: Stop owned Caddy and rebind all fixture ports.
cases.remaining: Add full suffix and invalid listener matrix against both binaries.

cases.contract: remote relay enrollment settings and credential paths
cases.trigger: Enroll a relay with private credential paths.
cases.effect: Both binaries accept the same enrollment and lease format.
cases.failure: Missing credentials, enrollment rejection and invalid relay settings fail.
cases.cleanup: Withdraw own lease and remove private credential copies.
cases.remaining: External deployment acceptance remains separate.

cases.contract: sorted errors, defaults and forbidden manifest Caddy settings
cases.trigger: Load defaults plus multiple invalid machine settings and forbidden manifest Caddy keys.
cases.effect: Defaults and ordered field diagnostics agree.
cases.failure: Manifest cannot override machine Caddy policy.
cases.cleanup: Remove read-only corpus fixtures.
cases.remaining: Add explicit sorted multi-error/default comparison.

cases.contract: service/group expansion, primary and alwaysStart behavior
cases.trigger: Start an included group containing primary, dependency and always-start services.
cases.effect: Exactly the expanded selection runs; stopped services can be started later.
cases.failure: Unknown group/service is rejected.
cases.cleanup: Stop every selected service and remove registrations.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: implicit dependencies, cycle detection and startup order
cases.trigger: Use implicit references, ordered dependencies and cyclic graphs.
cases.effect: Dependencies start before dependants without duplicate launches.
cases.failure: Cycles and missing references prevent startup.
cases.cleanup: Rollback already-started children on failure.
cases.remaining: Add cyclic graph runtime rollback assertion.

cases.contract: external and managed services, bindHost and proxyLocalOrigin
cases.trigger: Combine external and managed backends with bindHost and local-origin rewriting.
cases.effect: Managed process ownership and proxy origin match; external server is retained.
cases.failure: Unavailable external backend returns recovery/error response.
cases.cleanup: Stop owned stack while keeping external backend alive until its owner closes it.
cases.remaining: Add explicit bindHost/proxyLocalOrigin toggle comparison.

cases.contract: port reservation, injection, automatic collision retries and service references
cases.trigger: Start auto-port services with injected port and service-reference environment.
cases.effect: Chosen ports and references are visible to the correct child.
cases.failure: Occupied fixed ports fail; auto collisions retry within the bound.
cases.cleanup: Release claims and confirm ports can be rebound.
cases.remaining: Add forced auto-collision retry and injected-reference differential fixture.

cases.contract: process/TCP/HTTP/HTTPS checks, intervals and deadlines
cases.trigger: Start process-only, TCP and HTTP backends and vary readiness status.
cases.effect: Services become ready only under their selected checks and configured deadline.
cases.failure: Unhealthy status and timeout remain unavailable.
cases.cleanup: Cancel probes, stop children and release listeners.
cases.remaining: Add explicit interval/deadline comparison for all health modes.

cases.contract: fixed versus dynamic ports and bounded retries
cases.trigger: Start fixed and auto-port services while a port is occupied.
cases.effect: Fixed ownership is respected; dynamic retries remain bounded.
cases.failure: Exhausted retries roll back startup.
cases.cleanup: Remove claims and rebind successful and failed ports.
cases.remaining: Add forced fixed/automatic health retry comparison.

cases.contract: TLS verification and HTTP/2 health negotiation
cases.trigger: Serve TLS HTTP/2 health responses, first failing then succeeding.
cases.effect: Both binaries negotiate h2 and recover only on successful status.
cases.failure: Certificate and handshake failures never certify health.
cases.cleanup: Join TLS peer and stop stack.
cases.remaining: Verify untrusted health-certificate rejection separately from relay backend trust.

cases.contract: cancellation of pending health probes
cases.trigger: Cancel startup during a pending health request.
cases.effect: Supervisor and probe exit promptly without reporting readiness.
cases.failure: A hung backend cannot prevent cancellation.
cases.cleanup: Join probe and service children and close sockets.
cases.remaining: Run the pending-health cancellation fixture against Go, not just Rust APIs.

cases.contract: foreground processes and daemon start/status/stop helpers
cases.trigger: Launch a foreground service and a daemon with start/status/stop helpers.
cases.effect: Foreground and daemon readiness use their correct ownership and helper contracts.
cases.failure: Failed helper/status prevents readiness.
cases.cleanup: Invoke daemon stop, join supervisor and verify daemon PID is gone.
cases.remaining: Add failed status/stop-helper differential cases.

cases.contract: descendant tracking, detached children and PID identity checks
cases.trigger: Track child and detached descendant identities through exit and stale owner records.
cases.effect: Stop targets only matching process-start identities and live descendants.
cases.failure: A reused PID or corrupt identity must never authorize a signal.
cases.cleanup: Join owned process groups; preserve unrelated sentinel.
cases.remaining: Add external-binary descendant and wrong-start-identity sentinel comparison.

cases.contract: SIGINT/SIGTERM, cooperative cancellation and escalation
cases.trigger: Interrupt a cooperative daemon helper and terminate detached startup.
cases.effect: Helper receives TERM and supervisor returns the signal exit status promptly.
cases.failure: TERM-ignoring children require bounded escalation.
cases.cleanup: Verify helper death and no live stack owner remains.
cases.remaining: Add external-binary TERM-ignoring descendant escalation comparison.

cases.contract: inherited output pipes, invalid log bytes and retained tail
cases.trigger: Daemonize while retaining stdout and emit a non-UTF-8 line followed by valid text.
cases.effect: Readiness is not blocked by an open inherited pipe; subsequent logs remain visible.
cases.failure: Opaque bytes cannot terminate the reader or panic.
cases.cleanup: Stop daemon, verify death and rebind listener.
cases.remaining: Add retained-tail bounds comparison beyond invalid-byte continuation.

cases.contract: startup failure rollback and route/port/process cleanup
cases.trigger: Fail or cancel service and command-session startup after partial progress.
cases.effect: No failed session remains registered or routed.
cases.failure: A late child exit cannot leave claimed ports or serve success.
cases.cleanup: Join all children and verify own routes, claims and listeners are removed.
cases.remaining: Add multi-service partial-start rollback comparison.

cases.contract: manifest/include/config watches and service-cwd-relative globs
cases.trigger: Edit an included manifest, create a newly matched include and change a service-cwd watch file.
cases.effect: Affected services reload using service-relative glob paths.
cases.failure: An unreadable or invalid include retains last valid configuration.
cases.cleanup: Stop replacement and old children and remove watch state.
cases.remaining: Add machine config watch runtime comparison.

cases.contract: last-valid configuration, changed/removed services and transactional claims
cases.trigger: Reject a changed manifest and then repair it with changed/removed services.
cases.effect: Old valid route survives rejection; repaired routes replace it transactionally.
cases.failure: Conflicting claim or validation failure cannot withdraw working routes.
cases.cleanup: Remove old claims/routes only after accepted replacement.
cases.remaining: Add cross-stack claim conflict and removed-service differential checks.

cases.contract: unavailable backend, startup timeout and crash recovery
cases.trigger: Make an HTTP backend fail readiness, time out or crash, then recover it.
cases.effect: Recovery page stays available and service becomes ready after valid recovery.
cases.failure: Failed startup must not report healthy or wedge control reads.
cases.cleanup: Stop recovered child and owned callback/control listeners.
cases.remaining: Add crash-respawn and startup-timeout recovery comparisons.

cases.contract: on-demand starts, retries and dirty/restarting state
cases.trigger: Request a stopped on-demand service, then retry after failure and restart dirty configuration.
cases.effect: Requests start only eligible services; states move through starting/restarting/ready.
cases.failure: Concurrent requests must not duplicate launches.
cases.cleanup: Join requests and stop lazily launched children.
cases.remaining: Add shared request-driven on-demand/retry/dirty-state fixture.

cases.contract: request-driven idle shutdown including disabled negative durations
cases.trigger: Send traffic to an idle-managed service and configure positive, zero and negative durations.
cases.effect: Traffic renews positive timeout; negative duration disables idle stop.
cases.failure: No request must race an idle stop into an orphaned child.
cases.cleanup: Stop restarted idle service and release its claim.
cases.remaining: Negative parsing is compared; add positive request-driven idle lifecycle comparison.

cases.contract: bounded readiness acknowledgement and private append-only logs
cases.trigger: Launch twice with detach and an existing private log.
cases.effect: Parent acknowledges readiness within bound; logs append without becoming public.
cases.failure: Failed readiness returns diagnostics and no success acknowledgement.
cases.cleanup: Join detached supervisor and verify private log mode.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: idempotent launch locks, contention and manifest identity
cases.trigger: Race detached starts for the same canonical/symlinked manifest.
cases.effect: One supervisor owns the launch; contention is idempotent.
cases.failure: Unrelated manifest cannot steal the launch lock.
cases.cleanup: Stop owner and confirm lock can be reacquired.
cases.remaining: Run same-manifest concurrent contention fixture through both external CLIs.

cases.contract: startup cancellation, late exit and failure diagnostics
cases.trigger: Send TERM while detached startup is pending and simulate late child failure.
cases.effect: Startup cancels promptly and reports actual failure.
cases.failure: No late acknowledgement may survive parent cancellation.
cases.cleanup: Join helper/supervisor groups and remove partial owner records.
cases.remaining: Run late-exit failure diagnostics through both external CLIs.

cases.contract: live snapshot readiness and supervisor launch metadata
cases.trigger: Inspect a detached stack while service readiness changes.
cases.effect: Live snapshot overrides stale registration fields; launch metadata remains usable.
cases.failure: Malformed or unreachable control is reported rather than fabricated.
cases.cleanup: Stop detached owner and remove its live snapshot/registration.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: list/find/info with all owner record types and malformed-record errors
cases.trigger: List/find/info across stack, serve and port-claim owner records.
cases.effect: Matching owners are deduplicated and live readiness is used.
cases.failure: Malformed JSON names its record and returns error.
cases.cleanup: Stop only owned fixture processes and delete synthetic records.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: project stack restart and explicit manifest precedence
cases.trigger: Restart a selected project with explicit and environment manifest overrides.
cases.effect: Only its supervisor changes and launch context survives.
cases.failure: Invalid explicit manifest stops nothing.
cases.cleanup: Stop replacement and confirm old supervisor is reaped.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: project-scoped stack restart --all
cases.trigger: Run stack restart --all from a project with another stack alive.
cases.effect: All services in the current project restart; unrelated stack survives.
cases.failure: Explicit manifest overrides are rejected with this scope.
cases.cleanup: Stop both owned fixture stacks after assertions.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: global restart-all from any directory
cases.trigger: Run restart-all from a directory with no manifest.
cases.effect: All registered stacks and standalone sessions use the current executable.
cases.failure: Capture failure must abort before stopping any instance.
cases.cleanup: Join old/new owners and remove only fixture-owned routes.
cases.remaining: Add explicit unexpected launch-capture failure preserves-all fixture.

cases.contract: preserve environment, cwd, argv, log privacy and session identity
cases.trigger: Replace foreground, detached, file and command sessions with custom cwd/env/argv.
cases.effect: Context, private append log, domain and command-session identity survive.
cases.failure: Invalid launch metadata is diagnosed before destructive stop.
cases.cleanup: Join old PID and replacement and inspect private log permissions.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: global restart retires missing launch directories and continues healthy replacements; unexpected capture failure stops nothing
cases.trigger: Delete a launch cwd or rename a served root while another session is healthy.
cases.effect: Missing cwd owner is retired; unreadable root stays live; healthy replacement succeeds.
cases.failure: Unexpected capture failure stops nothing and returns a diagnostic.
cases.cleanup: Remove orphan route/record, preserve Caddy PID and join replacements.
cases.remaining: Add explicit capture-failure sentinel coverage alongside existing missing-path cases.

cases.contract: linked, detached, locked and submodule checkouts
cases.trigger: Discover real linked, detached, locked and submodule checkouts.
cases.effect: Worktree identity and eligibility match Git state.
cases.failure: Locked/missing/invalid targets are rejected safely.
cases.cleanup: Remove linked checkouts through Git after stopping their services.
cases.remaining: Linked runtime path is compared; add detached/locked/submodule CLI differential cases.

cases.contract: repository grouping, default branch and saved selections
cases.trigger: Enable repository grouping and save a selection away from default branch.
cases.effect: All members switch together; saved selection restores after supervisor replacement.
cases.failure: Invalid saved selection reports unavailable group without partial start.
cases.cleanup: Restore fixture repository and remove private selection file.
cases.remaining: Add explicit default-branch discovery variants.

cases.contract: switching, occupied-owner stop, refresh and missing checkout recovery
cases.trigger: Switch to an occupied target, refresh Git checkouts and remove a selected checkout.
cases.effect: Owned competing group stops; unavailable target is handled without stale routes.
cases.failure: Unrelated owners cannot be stopped by a selection.
cases.cleanup: Stop both fixture stacks and remove checkout registrations.
cases.remaining: Add occupied-owner and missing-checkout runtime comparison.

cases.contract: transactional rollback and stopped-group retry
cases.trigger: Fail one service during a group switch, then retry a stopped member.
cases.effect: Whole group rolls back transactionally and a member retry restarts the group.
cases.failure: Failed restoration leaves the group stopped, never half-switched.
cases.cleanup: Join failed/rolled-back children and clean claims.
cases.remaining: Existing differential checks failed path selection; add failed restoration and stopped-group retry.

cases.contract: stop --worktrees and disabling worktree controls
cases.trigger: Disable worktrees and invoke stop --worktrees.
cases.effect: Controls disappear and only relevant worktree groups stop.
cases.failure: Invalid worktree mode fails without stopping unrelated services.
cases.cleanup: Stop all fixture-owned checkouts and remove selections.
cases.remaining: Add live stop --worktrees across two repository groups.

cases.contract: required explicit domain, local-only routing and manifest bypass
cases.trigger: Run file serving with an explicit domain next to an invalid manifest.
cases.effect: Session bypasses manifest discovery and uses local-only routing.
cases.failure: Missing domain or remote-incompatible mode fails before launch.
cases.cleanup: Stop standalone session and remove own route.
cases.remaining: Add invalid neighbouring-manifest and local-only route comparison.

cases.contract: file or external-port mode, mutually exclusive arguments
cases.trigger: Serve a directory, then an existing external port.
cases.effect: File bytes or external response are routed under the explicit domain.
cases.failure: Conflicting dir/port/command arguments are rejected.
cases.cleanup: Close owned file listener; external listener remains until fixture closes it.
cases.remaining: Add explicit external-port serve CLI mode comparison.

cases.contract: isolated sessions, shared Caddy ownership and route cleanup
cases.trigger: Run two standalone sessions through one isolated Caddy and stop one.
cases.effect: Their routes and owner records stay independent; Caddy remains live.
cases.failure: Duplicate host conflict cannot replace a foreign session.
cases.cleanup: Stop both sessions, then owned Caddy and rebind ports.
cases.remaining: Add concurrent file-session host-claim conflict comparison.

cases.contract: preserve external services on session stop
cases.trigger: Stop a session which proxies a server started by the fixture.
cases.effect: Its route disappears while the external server PID stays alive.
cases.failure: Failed backend route does not authorize killing external process.
cases.cleanup: Owner joins external backend after verifying preservation.
cases.remaining: External manifest backend is compared; add standalone external-port session variant.

cases.contract: quoted shell command or direct argv after --
cases.trigger: Run a quoted shell command and direct argv after --.
cases.effect: Child sees correct argument boundaries and serves HTTP.
cases.failure: Invalid mixed input mode exits nonzero.
cases.cleanup: Stop command process group and withdraw session route.
cases.remaining: Add explicit argv-with-spaces comparison alongside existing shell command fixture.

cases.contract: inferred repository/cwd names, --name sanitation and random session ID
cases.trigger: Infer name from repository/cwd and provide a name requiring sanitization.
cases.effect: Stable sanitized labels and random session identifiers are recorded.
cases.failure: Malformed private session ID is rejected.
cases.cleanup: Stop named sessions and remove registration.
cases.remaining: Add repository-name and sanitation matrix comparison.

cases.contract: contained listener ownership, HTTP HEAD verification and non-HTTP rejection
cases.trigger: Open real HTTP and unsupported TCP listeners from contained children.
cases.effect: Only owned listeners that answer HTTP HEAD get routes.
cases.failure: Unrelated or non-HTTP listeners never become session backends.
cases.cleanup: Join contained children and fixture TCP peer.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: startup deadline, early exit and detached readiness
cases.trigger: Detach a healthy command, start an early-exit command and wait on a no-HTTP command.
cases.effect: Healthy detach acknowledges readiness; failed starts obey deadline.
cases.failure: Early exit/no HTTP returns nonzero and no session.
cases.cleanup: Join supervisor/children and verify zero own routes/owners.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: late/closed listener reconciliation, qualified hosts and stable short alias
cases.trigger: Open and close additional HTTP listeners after readiness.
cases.effect: Qualified domains update while the short alias stays stable.
cases.failure: Closed or unsupported listeners lose routes.
cases.cleanup: Close all listeners and ensure alias/qualified routes disappear on stop.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: stack list --sessions, stack info --session and stop --session
cases.trigger: List sessions, inspect by name and stop by session selector.
cases.effect: Records expose correct identity and named controls select one session.
cases.failure: Absent session gives error rather than affecting other stacks.
cases.cleanup: Stop selected and remaining fixture sessions.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: stable generated name across global supervisor replacement
cases.trigger: Run global restart on a command with an inferred name.
cases.effect: Replacement preserves generated name and session ID.
cases.failure: Failed replacement does not silently rename or duplicate it.
cases.cleanup: Join old supervisor and replacement, remove routes.
cases.remaining: None beyond native platform acceptance.

cases.contract: download pinned platform artifact and validate settings
cases.trigger: Provision the pinned native Caddy artifact and start with selected listeners.
cases.effect: Artifact version and platform match; configured HTTP/HTTPS respond.
cases.failure: Unsupported or invalid settings cannot create a healthy receipt.
cases.cleanup: Stop owned Caddy; retain only reusable verified dependency cache.
cases.remaining: Native artifact layout/smoke evidence is separate from full lifecycle acceptance.

cases.contract: start/stop/trust and foreign-instance protection
cases.trigger: Start/stop an owned Caddy and inspect foreign-instance/trust boundaries.
cases.effect: Owned runtime stops; foreign identity is preserved; certificate lookup uses selected state.
cases.failure: Unavailable trust material reports a diagnostic without changing host trust.
cases.cleanup: Use isolated trust inputs; join owned runtime only.
cases.remaining: Add differential foreign-runtime stop protection and isolated trust-install probes.

cases.contract: bound admin readiness and persistent applied listener settings
cases.trigger: Start Caddy twice, then change saved listener settings.
cases.effect: Admin readiness is bounded; already-applied listener policy remains explicit.
cases.failure: Unreachable admin or invalid configuration never certifies ready.
cases.cleanup: Stop owned runtime and rebind saved ports.
cases.remaining: Add unreachable-admin deadline comparison.

cases.contract: serialized restart generations and fresh-process receipts
cases.trigger: Apply an old runtime generation and then request the current generation twice.
cases.effect: First call starts a fresh PID; receipt is tied to PID/start identity; second is idempotent.
cases.failure: Failed restart cannot certify the old process or mutate a newer generation.
cases.cleanup: Join old/current processes; preserve CA and remove fixture state.
cases.remaining: Add failed-restart and concurrent mutation comparison against both external CLIs.

cases.contract: privileged ports, local root certificate and remote trust commands
cases.trigger: Print a fixture CA and exercise local/remote trust command preconditions.
cases.effect: Raw certificate and command exit contract agree.
cases.failure: Missing/empty certificate and invalid remote settings return errors.
cases.cleanup: Never install into the real host trust store during comparisons.
cases.remaining: Privileged listener and OS trust acceptance require isolated native hosts.

cases.contract: route order, hostname/path overlap and reverse proxy headers
cases.trigger: Proxy document, path and named command routes through native Caddy.
cases.effect: Specific route ordering, upstream paths and forwarded headers agree.
cases.failure: Conflicting hosts/paths cannot route to another stack silently.
cases.cleanup: Withdraw only fixture routes before joining backends.
cases.remaining: Add direct overlapping path/hostname precedence comparison.

cases.contract: loopback binding, local origin rewriting and devtools origin
cases.trigger: Use loopback-bound origins with local and relay requests.
cases.effect: Rewritten local origin and devtools origin preserve intended routing.
cases.failure: Spoofed control origin is rejected.
cases.cleanup: Join proxy, control and backend listeners.
cases.remaining: Add explicit local-origin rewriting disable/enable toggle comparison.

cases.contract: manifest identity, host claims and owner liveness
cases.trigger: Register symlinked manifests and stale process identities, then claim a hostname.
cases.effect: Canonical identity deduplicates valid owners; only matching live identity authorizes ownership.
cases.failure: Foreign live host claims cannot be stolen.
cases.cleanup: Remove synthetic owner records; preserve foreign sentinel process.
